content:
Something is off with the lean-action configuration of lake test in CI. If I locally run lake test --wfail --iofail, there are two warnings (introduced by recent implicit_reducible changes) and the build fails as expected. However in CI, where we have lean-action configured with test-args: "--wfail --iofail", there is no failure.

I made the PR adding test-args to lean-action so it could be my own mistake there, but it's not jumping out at me. In CI runs in CSLib, it appears this argument if not being passed to the action. I'd appreciate a second pair of eyes, as it could be something simple I'm overlooking.
Ah great, thank you! Sorry for the trouble on your end as well.
So that we don't have to wait on a release of the action, I have opened cslib#422 that sets the appropriate environment variable manually.
